title: Less-repeated Skills picks
reader_summary: Remember more of the recent Skills list and penalize repeats harder, so more unique repos show up week to week.
outcome_line: Baseline snapshot imported (sparse PostHog). Treatment starts 2026-09-13.
hypothesis: Stronger soft-dedup (14-day window, 0.15 penalty) reduces consecutive-day list overlap and raises weekly unique / NEW share on Skills digests, while still ranking by 7-day momentum so the list stays about discovery of real activity.
change_summary: Tighten soft-dedup for Skills digests only: DIGEST_SOFT_DEDUP_BRIEFINGS=14 and DIGEST_SOFT_DEDUP_PENALTY=0.15 (defaults today: 5 and 0.5).
notes: Baseline PostHog snapshot imported 2026-09-12 PT: 2 Skills briefing pageviews (2026-09-01 only), 2 Skills index pageviews, 0 outbound_repo_click with edition=skills (one OSS outbound_repo_click existed in window, excluded). Traffic sparse; secondary only. Primary keep/revert gate remains structural diversity from digest.json. Treatment 2026-09-13 to 2026-09-26: enable DIGEST_SOFT_DEDUP_BRIEFINGS=14 and DIGEST_SOFT_DEDUP_PENALTY=0.15 on Skills digest command only. Backlog: RANK-2.
